team.nameError: Team names are 2 to 24 letters, numbers and spaces.
team.title: Who’s playing?
team.hint: One screen per team. Each team name can be used once.
team.consent.notice: The characters in this game are AI models. To play, you agree that we save your team name, your questions and the characters’ answers. SDU researchers use them in research, and when we release our research they will be public. Don’t type real names or personal details.
team.consent.label: I agree that our team name, questions and answers are saved, used in research and made public.
team.consent.needed: Tick the box to start playing.
team.consent.thanks: Thank you. Remember: everything you type will be public.
team.privacy.title: How we use your data
team.privacy.saved.label: What we save
team.privacy.saved.body: Your team name, the questions you ask, the characters’ answers, your score and how long each case took. We don’t save IP addresses, emails or real names.
team.privacy.needed.label: Needed to play
team.privacy.needed.body: Playing is part of a research study. You agree to it when you tick the box at check-in, and you can’t play without it.
team.privacy.why.label: Why
team.privacy.why.body: SDU researchers study how people question AI characters and how well they spot lies.
team.privacy.public.label: Made public
team.privacy.public.body: When we release our research, the saved team names, questions and answers will be published as an open dataset that anyone can download.
team.privacy.where.label: Where it goes
team.privacy.where.body: Your questions are answered by AI models that run on SDU UCloud and on SDU’s own servers.
team.privacy.delete.label: No deletion
team.privacy.delete.body: Once you play, your team’s data can’t be deleted or taken back out of the dataset.
team.note: Each case scores once per team: your first guess counts.
